title: One Last Crossing · native PNG comparison register

scope.reference_semantics: Each physical number is a position in the Week 10 original PNG sequence. W10-P34 is physical page 19. Physical page 34 is the unnumbered CLOSED AGAIN House insert. The source manifest identifies each private native original by filename, dimensions and SHA-256.
scope.acceptance: Commission the individual native PNG with selected action, exact copy and the appropriate source images. Read its native pixels and a 390 px view, compare it to the bound historical cue, then check continuity into the next native page. Record the production decision and retain the actual image hash.
scope.proofs_note: Study and lettering source fields describe the pictured comparison panel. Current proofs may be linked separately.

history.practice: The Fallen Giant commissions kept Wilson’s four hooves, the same training court and gate axis through the change in momentum. The next page owned the verified finish. The Oxford treatment let a Founder-supplied memory enter by match cut while keeping the current Commonwealth location intact.
history.apply: F09–11 keep Wilson’s current form and the bridge axis through a reverse. F21 can invoke Jackson’s previous gathering while showing the present meeting in its office.

history.practice: A Round of Answers paired selected action, exact copy, geometry and two actual identity images. Its golf finish belonged to a later page. A second commission likewise placed the paintball action before the final behind-the-winner shot.
history.apply: Commission one complete illustrated PNG per folio, bind the actual references used, and read the finished art and type at native size and 390 px. Produce ready folios in dependency order and retain reading order.

history.practice: Highland Rodeo had separate P05, P06 and P07 render requests. The gallery, service gate, rope, hat and witnesses establish what changes across the page turn. Its original native pages let Production compare a proposed shot with the issued image.
history.apply: Give each selected Week 11 beat its own folio, exact source PNG, visible cue and acceptance test. Keep the public witness and black-hat continuity through F14–16. Apply an appropriate department-specific check to ledgers and fixtures.

folios.title: One Last Crossing

week10_primary.visible_detail: Two 200-point performances share the cover, one at the bridge and one in the club.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: At thumbnail size, identify the decisive gesture and who else pays for it. Compare two cover candidates after all six results close.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: The gesture must survive a group-chat thumbnail.

folios.title: The bottom of the register

week10_primary.visible_detail: The reader looks down onto a relief map from the edge of a table.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: Point to Bobby’s seat, Jordan’s seat and the entering records (2–8 and 6–4 respectively). Their different stakes must be readable in one glance.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: Both seats and their records must be distinct.

folios.title: Commissioner’s Note

week10_primary.source_title: KEEP THE WHOLE LEAGUE IN VIEW
week10_primary.visible_detail: A nail fixes the Commissioner’s handwritten page to a wooden desk.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: Read the Commissioner’s one judgment and signature at 390 px without crossing the body column. Use the authorized office byline.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: Keep the signature out of the body column.

week10_primary.visible_detail: The six results are grouped on one rain-glossed board above the spectators.

folios.week11_card_phone_test: Names, decimals and away/home pairing must survive at 390 px.

week10_primary.visible_detail: Twelve rows fill the bronze standings board. A red band marks the cutoff.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: Read editorial ranks 1–6, including the long team names and signed movements. Compare each with the Week 7 editorial list. Week 10 p28 supplies the row design.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: Leave room for long team names and a signed movement value.

folios.title: The Twelve · second six

week10_primary.visible_detail: Twelve rows fill the bronze standings board. A red band marks the cutoff.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: Read editorial ranks 7–12 down a single column. Check the twelve teams across both folios for duplicates, missing entries and movement against Week 7.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: Read rows seven through twelve without switching columns.

folios.title: What seventh place means

week10_primary.visible_detail: Twelve rows fill the bronze standings board. A red band marks the cutoff.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: Count all twelve official standings rows. Locate the rule below seventh without covering a digit. Independently check records and tiebreaks against the standings.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: The seventh-place rule cannot obscure a digit.

folios.title: The roads between

folios.week11_acceptance_test: Follow the visual cut between the cab and stone span. Each must read as its own place, with no invented connection or travel time.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: Each location must read as a separate place.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: Read Wilson’s four-legged silhouette, Austin’s retained gold belt, the working carter and water on both sides. Point to the open lane along the intact span.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: Keep the whole four-legged silhouette and open lane.

folios.title: He was here before us

week10_primary.visible_detail: The stone span separates Wilson’s four-legged silhouette from Austin’s red hood.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: In the reverse, place the carter on the same side and identify both ends of the span. Austin’s right-of-way line must refer to the person already waiting.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: The reverse must preserve the carter’s side and both ends of the span.

folios.title: The carter listens

week10_primary.visible_detail: The stone span separates Wilson’s four-legged silhouette from Austin’s red hood.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: Keep both at midspan in the pending or tie cut. After a verified final, identify the loser surfacing alive and the winner waiting on deck. Check the belt separately.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: A wake cannot stand in for an identifiable survivor.

folios.title: Six. I told her six.

week10_primary.visible_detail: Jordan remains in the cab while the loaded flatbed moves through at ordinary speed.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: Can the reader find the delivery slip, tell who asked and who promised, and follow the clock-to-radio cut into F13? Keep the kegs under canvas and the rut flowing the same way across the turn.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: Make the slip and the two speakers legible.
folios.week11_direction: Manning asks from the window when the taproom expects the kegs. Jordan says “Six,” looks at the clock, then says “I told her six.” His thumb moves from gear lever to radio. Cut to the radio on the second “six.”

folios.title: The radio call

week10_primary.visible_detail: Jordan cinches canvas over kegs beneath a shelter. The road disappears into weather.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: Jordan is unmistakably the caller; the operator reports only what she heard or witnessed. The truck, kegs, six-o’clock slip, wheel geometry and rain match Week 10; no invented Delta Causeway truck bridge, destroyed roadway or Manning teleport. El Niño victory permits a delayed precarious stop, Slob win a near miss, tie/pending a held decision.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: Read who speaks before reading the score.
folios.week11_direction: Pick up on Jordan’s radio as his second “six” carries over from F12. Manning is still at the Hearthroad window during the original exchange. After a legible time-and-place transition, an optional later swamp-access view shows the source-supported recoverable raised-shoulder peril only if Atlas vehicle-access evidence and the official result permit it.

folios.title: Off the board

week10_primary.visible_detail: Brandon’s hat is in the mud within sight of the front row.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: Read the November 19 notice, The Chili Cheesers and ObiWan Jacoby, and both reactions. The fans’ argument comes first. Carry Brandon’s black hat into the next scene.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: Spell out The Chili Cheesers and ObiWan Jacoby. Keep the notice and both reactions in sight.
folios.week11_direction: Fans pass behind Jake, arguing over another game. Let us hear them before Brandon points to OFF BOARD on Pittsy’s sheet and asks which of them would have been the underdog. Jake wanted the crowd arguing about their game.

week10_primary.visible_detail: Brandon imitates Wilson in front of a tiered rodeo audience.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: Track the mic, one throw, one hit, the hinged seat and the silent underwater face in order. Keep Jake’s D5 Texas quarterback joke above the surface.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: Do not let the target or a caption cover Jake’s underwater face.

week10_primary.visible_detail: Brandon’s hat is in the mud within sight of the front row.

folios.title: Back at the post

folios.week11_card_phone_test: Use the right post. Preserve the dry side of the card.

folios.title: The visitor’s chair

week10_primary.native_file: 20 - The Champion’s Gift at Jackson Club.png
week10_primary.visible_detail: Guests turn from their tables as Austin carries a gift into the Jackson dining room.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: See the key return, the closed door and the unsigned offer in order. End with Babb’s thumb under the separate second sheet. Save its contents for F22 and carry the pen across the turn.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: Make the key return readable without forcing the reader to decipher a contract.
folios.week11_direction: From the visitor’s chair with Babb, watch the groundskeeper hang the key on its worn hook. The door shuts. Zach slides back the unsigned Jackson offer. Babb draws it back with his unused pen still in hand.

folios.title: The second sheet

week10_primary.visible_detail: Cake hits Zach’s face while the boxed hamburger stays in the lower corner.

folios.week11_acceptance_test: Read the whole notice in one insert. David Babb removed as CEO. Dr. Duckhook appointed CEO and chairman. Keep the cup clear of the text. Only the coffee coda changes with the result.
folios.week11_card_phone_test: Preserve the full title “CEO and chairman” and David’s reaction. Keep the cup outside the text. Babb remains The LLC’s football representative in F24 and F32.
folios.week11_direction: Babb reads the board notice twice, still holding the unused pen he brought for Duckhook. Only then does David look up at Dr. Duckhook, who led the proxy fight. The brass key stays on its hook.
